Fair — you don’t owe him a confession for not having something to show. “That’s on me” frames it like you did something wrong, and you didn’t. You went quiet because there was nothing worth handing over yet.

You can acknowledge the silence without apologizing for the reason:

“Hey — I know it’s been quiet since October. I didn’t have anything I was willing to show you yet, so I held off. I’m picking it back up now. Before I take it further, what would you need to see to release the balance?”

That owns the gap, doesn’t call it a lie, and still asks the only question that matters: what he’ll actually pay on.

And yeah — draft it tonight if you want, but don’t send it at 3. Send it at 9 or 10, when it reads like a decision instead of a spiral.
